Packet-caused hang on valid input, 2/42 held-out (batch DE, relay opus-g5-checker-heldout, results 76776af3...). ock_region_history_by_own_name and ock_region_deep_history_by_own_name: Java exit 0 with a real diagram (text Bailey|Solar|CONC2|H|Pantry and Chancel|Tympanum|Solar|Pantry|CONC3|H*|Buttery). Base 2971000d4 and parity-recovery 32684f81e exit 0 in about 0.1 s. The tip never terminates (killed at 20 s, exit 124). Mechanism: inside region Bailey.CONC2, `CONC2[H] --> Pantry` reaches ensure_state's history branch (parse/state.rs:808ff), which resolves the base through resolve_state_id with StateNameUse::Link, so the current-group short-circuit returns the scope Bailey.CONC2 itself. ensure_state then pushes a State for that synthetic region with parent = current_scope() = Bailey.CONC2, i.e. its own parent. mute_to_state removes it from concurrent_now. check_final_error -> nearest_concurrent_ancestor (parse/state.rs:694-703) then loops forever, because quark_parent (parse/state.rs:585) returns the id itself and it is no longer concurrent.

Java trace for the hang cases. CommandLinkStateCommon.getEntity tests `code.endsWith("[H]")` / `[H*]` (CommandLinkStateCommon.java:171-177) before the current-group short-circuit at :189-190, and calls StateDiagram.getHistorical(location, idShort) / getDeepHistory(location, idShort) (StateDiagram.java:142, :177). Those call quarkInContext(true, "CONC2"); countByName is 1 but the quark is the current group, so CucaDiagram.quarkInContextSafe returns currentQuark.child("CONC2") (CucaDiagram.java:264-272), i.e. Bailey.CONC2.CONC2, which gotoGroup creates as a STATE group holding the history pseudo-state. Minimal fix: (1) in the X[H]/X[H*] branch, resolve X with the quarkInContext rule and no current-group short-circuit (count == 1 and that quark is the current group means the current group's child); (2) a synthetic region's parent is its owner, never itself: do not create a State whose parent equals its own id, and make nearest_concurrent_ancestor start from the parent and stop on a repeated id.

minimal_fix: Parser only. (1) X[H]/X[H*]: resolve X by the quarkInContext rule with no current-group short-circuit, so the region's own name yields the current group's child (StateDiagram.getHistorical/getDeepHistory with idShort, CommandLinkStateCommon.java:171-177).
